description: Low-level ARM assembly implementation of AES encryption/decryption primitives, including bit-sliced AES for ARM NEON, key schedule conversion, and CBC/CTR encryption routines for the BoringSSL project.

methods.name: _bsaes_decrypt8
methods.description: Decryption primitive for 8 blocks of AES using ARM NEON.

methods.name: _bsaes_encrypt8
methods.description: Encryption primitive for 8 blocks of AES using ARM NEON.

methods.name: _bsaes_key_convert
methods.description: Converts AES key into bit-sliced format for ARM NEON.

methods.name: bsaes_cbc_encrypt
methods.description: AES CBC mode encryption using BoringSSL's ARM assembly primitives.

methods.name: bsaes_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
methods.description: AES CTR mode encryption for multiple blocks using ARM assembly.
